use_cases: Triggering form submissions or actions with click events
Navigating users between pages or sections
Toggling boolean UI states like modals or dropdowns
Serving as child component slot via asChild prop for composition
ai_summary: A reusable Button component built with Radix UI Slot and class-variance-authority for flexible styling. Supports multiple visual variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes (default, sm, lg, icon). Implements forwardRef pattern for proper DOM access and uses cn utility for class merging. Extends native button HTML attributes for full accessibility compliance.
